name: fig24_thermofield_pair_entropy
caption: Truncated two-mode squeezed (Bogoliubov-pair) state |Psi> = sqrt(1-q) sum_n q^{n/2}|n>_in|n>_out with q = exp(-hbar omega/k_B T_H). The global state is pure; tracing out the interior gives the thermal Bose distribution with <n> = 1/(e^x - 1) and entropy (n+1)ln(n+1) - n ln n. d = 2 reproduces the large-x limit (a qubit) only. Convergence in d is geometric, faster at large x. This models the mode structure, not the near-horizon field dynamics that produce it.
